question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing right winger, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing striker, Fred is playing cheerleader, and Gertrude is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Claire trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. Finally, Claire and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) left back
(C) right winger
(D) right back
(E) striker
(F) cheerleader
(G) left winger
solution:
Positions are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (fullback, left back, right winger, right back, striker, cheerleader, left winger)
1. Dave ↔ Bob: (fullback, right back, right winger, left back, striker, cheerleader, left winger)
2. Dave ↔ Alice: (left back, right back, right winger, fullback, striker, cheerleader, left winger)
3. Bob ↔ Gertrude: (left back, left winger, right winger, fullback, striker, cheerleader, right back)
4. Fred ↔ Claire: (left back, left winger, cheerleader, fullback, striker, right winger, right back)
5. Fred ↔ Eve: (left back, left winger, cheerleader, fullback, right winger, striker, right back)
6. Gertrude ↔ Fred: (left back, left winger, cheerleader, fullback, right winger, right back, striker)
7. Claire ↔ Eve: (left back, left winger, right winger, fullback, cheerleader, right back, striker)
Alice is playing left back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
